spans.s:
The गति-s नि and अधि however retain their original accent before अञ्च् when the affix व् follows.

Terms: समास accent

ऐ is placed before the य् of न्यग्रोध instead of वृद्धि when the word stands alone and is not a member of a compound and is followed by a तद्धित affix with the indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् ।

Terms: Peculiar वृद्धि

The guttural is substituted in न्यङ्क्वु etc..

Terms: Guttarlisation
